videos.title: Documentary 360
videos.description: Anatomist Yoro Takeshi has spent decades exploring life and death. Now confronting his own mortality after a cancer diagnosis, what thoughts does he have to share on the nature of human existence.

videos.title: NHK Newsline
videos.description: NHK Newsline brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

videos.title: Encounters with Art
videos.description: Yayoi Kusama creates original costumes she regards as the source of her creativity. This programme follows the artist at work and explores the ideas behind her art. Originally aired in Japan in 2001.

videos.title: The Cat's Eye Museum
videos.description: World-famous artist Yayoi Kusama is known for polka dots. A giant pumpkin, mysterious ladder, and a chandelier expand into infinity. Explore her world with two unusual cats.

videos.title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan
videos.description: From natural landscapes to historic architecture representing centuries of cultural development, Japan's World Heritage sites offer a wide range of glimpses into history and the beauty of nature.

videos.title: Grand Sumo Live
videos.description: NHK World-Japan will broadcast Grand Sumo November Tournament Day 14 action live from Fukuoka, as top wrestlers have their fourteenth bouts of the 15-day contest.

videos.title: Design X Stories
videos.description: Today's theme: The New Era of Japanese Modern Design. A fusion of rational Western Modernism and traditional Japanese materials and skills. Explore the beauty and potential of Japanese Modern Design.

videos.title: Story Land
videos.description: Leading actors take turns as solo storytellers to act and recite traditional folk tales loved in Japan for centuries. Watch out, too, for the delightful illustrations.
